lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Thanks for calling the practice. I'm the digital assistant. This call is recorded for quality. How can I help?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, I've had some knee pain for a couple of weeks. Could I book an appointment this week?

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me check availability. There's Wednesday at ten thirty in the morning. Or Thursday at three in the afternoon. Would either suit you?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thursday at three, please. Actually, sorry, could we do Friday morning instead?

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Of course. Friday the eighteenth of September at ten in the morning is available. Does that work?

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Can I take your full name, please?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Priya Nair. That's Nair, N A I R.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Thanks, Priya. And a contact number?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It's zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero, one two three.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Let me read that back. Zero seven seven zero zero; nine zero zero; one two three. Is that right?

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Would you prefer your appointment confirmation by email or text?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Email, please. It's priya at example dot com.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: That's priya at example dot com. Have I got that right?

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: You're booked for Friday the eighteenth of September, at ten in the morning. Your confirmation email will include the practice address and how to reschedule. Is there anything else you need?
